GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok drifted back 8l off, limited room turn, Straightened Up well off, plodded home # back/no threat
stayed in barrier and missed kick 6 Lengths , ridden hard to keep in tact back last 9 Lengths 800m, nose roll again #
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly with its head up and lost ground.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fair drifted back to last 9l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, plodded home # back/no threat
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: From a wide barrier was shifted behind runners in the early stages. Passing the 200m, when being shifted wider to continue into clear running, got its head up and became awkwardly placed on heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Away fairly. Not pushed early & raced Worse than midfield Two Wide (6L from lead). Held Ground until pushed to quicken 3 Wide @ 500m. Pushed along Six Wide @ 400m & pressured on home turn. Laid in & made a little ground in straight. Vetted - 2/5 lame off fore. # Pulled up lame.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shortly after the start, shifted in and bumped another runner. Travelled keenly throughout the early and middle stages. Bumped with another runner rounding the turn near the 900m. Near the 500m was eased when tightened between runners. A post-race vet exam revealed the gelding to be lame (2/5) in the off-fore. Tnr was advised to provide a vetr clearance prior to the gelding racing or trialling again. Vet clearance received.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Not Bustled 2nd last 8-9l. well back and Hard Ridden to Turn . Straightened Up all to do widest, Ran On Very Strongly and Made Good Ground into 2nd. winner away # big run from rear
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: On jumping shifted out and bumped. Shortly after had to be steadied to avoid heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , Settled Worse than midfield Two Wide With Cover 6 Lengths 800m, Ridden Along and still well off them between runners soon after Straightening Up , angled into Clear last 150m and finished off strongly into second spot # ran on strongly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Trainer reported on return to his stable, the gelding had an abrasion on its near-hind, consistent with having been galloped on.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: jumped ok. Settled Down 8th Two Wide 6 L. Straightened Up 8th under riding b/t horses. checked off heels near 200m and made progress to line. nose roll on. # check 200m/ran on
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Approaching the 200m was checked after improving onto heels. Trainer reported bruising to the gelding’s eye, following the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok out deep, Restrained 2nd last 10l. too far back doing nil Turn and No Run On in Straight # went back from gate
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: From the outside barrier was directed behind runners during the early stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: (gelded), Jumped Ok , Ridden Along Mid Field 3 Wide With Cover 6 Lengths 600m, dropped out in Straight , Blinkers First Time # dropped out
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shortly after the start was bumped. Travelled keenly throughout the early stages. After improving onto heels near the 800m, was checked and directed outwards before being bumped and blundering severely. Travelled wide and without cover for the majority of the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped fairly. Pushed fwd & shared lead Two Wide early . Stayed =lead Two Wide midrace & pushed along =lead 3 Wide on home turn. Pressured @ 300m & weakened in straight. Rider - failed to handle shifting track. Blinkers First Time # On-pace/tired.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider reported that her mount, which was having its first race start, failed to handle the shifting track conditions and did not travel comfortably at any stage of the event. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.
